subject: Private-stack packaging, amortized platform fee & ops-retainer clarifications
messages:
From: Jordan Myers <jordan.myers@acmehealth.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private deployment packaging questions

Hi Markus / Monica,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — it helped our infra and security teams get a feel for the flow. Procurement is pulling together a commercial picture for our director today and we have a few open items before we can circulate an ask: 

1) Platform fee amortization: can you confirm the suggested accounting treatment if we elect a 3-year committed plan? Specifically we need the annualized numbers (platform fee spread vs. CAPEX).
2) Support tiers: we saw Bronze/Silver/Gold in the slide but need concrete SLAs and on-call retainer amounts.
3) On-prem / air-gapped: what licensing model changes (if any) are required for on-prem enclosed installs (i.e. per-node vs. per-seat)?

Can you send a one-page that we can attach to the internal packet + a sample SOW? Even a stub is fine.

Appreciate quick turnaround — director review tomorrow afternoon.

Best,
Jordan
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Health

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear list. I've attached two files: 20261001_Redwood_Private_Pricing_Options.xlsx (spreadsheet with amortized scenarios) and draft-SOW-acme-2026-10-01.pdf (sample SOW / deliverables). High level answers below, then a quick suggested next step.

High-level answers:
- Platform fee amortization: spreadsheet tab "Amortized-3yr" shows annual platform fee spread and the equivalent monthly run-rate; we recommend capitalizing the platform fee over the contract term for budgeting visibility. See rows 18–26 for the per-year view.
- Support tiers: Bronze = business-hours email, Silver = 24/7 monitoring + 4h response, Gold = 24/7 with 1h on-call SLA + named-Engineer. The spreadsheet includes retainer amounts by tier and a note on incident credits.
- On‑prem licensing: standard on-prem package is per-node licensed with an optional operator-seat add-on for devops tooling. Air‑gapped installs are the same license model but require an ops retainer for offline upgrades.

Suggested next step: if this looks good, can we propose a 3-year commit with a 12% starter credit applied in year 1 (reduces net platform fee) and a 9-month deployment SOW milestone schedule? If so, I can turn the draft SOW into an official version for signatures.

Cheers,
Markus Klein
Director, Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Jordan — quick detail from the ops side.

A few practical notes to include in your packet:
- Amortization examples in our spreadsheet assume a flat platform fee with support retainer listed separately. If Acme wants to capitalize the retainer, we can model that but typical accounting keeps retainer as OPEX.
- Upgrade path for air-gapped: we ship signed bundles and provide an upgrade-runbook; upgrades beyond major versions incur an engineering migration fee (one-time).
- Discounting: for a 3-year, we can offer the following stacking: 10% multi-year discount + up to a 5% ARR volume rebate if usage exceeds the threshold in year 2. Stated another way, baseline 10% off list, potential 15% at scale.

I'll also flag two optional add-ons you might want to list:
- Staging cluster support (recommended for first 90 days — included in Gold)
- Security attestation package (SOC2 evidence + runbook) — one-off fee.

If you want, I can convert the spreadsheet into a single-sheet "For Director" summary.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
From: Jordan Myers <jordan.myers@acmehealth.com>

Subject: RE: Private deployment packaging questions

Thanks Mark/Monica — this is helpful. A couple follow-ups the director asked for: 

- Can you show the net P&L impact if we apply the 12% starter credit in year 1 and then the 10% multi-year discount afterwards? A single-line net spend per year would be ideal.
- For air‑gapped installs: confirm whether the per-node license requires recurring certificates (we'd like to avoid frequent manual renewals).
- Can you add a one-page ops-retainer summary that spells out response times, escalation path, and on-site options (if needed)?

We need these three items in a single PDF by end of day 2026-10-02 to include in the director packet. Is that feasible?

Jordan
Procurement — Acme Health

Jordan — looping in with the finance/ops clarifications you asked for. Apologies for the short delay.

Answers and deliverables we can provide by EOD today (attached as support-tier-matrix.csv and a single-page summary):
- Net P&L: attached spreadsheet now has a new tab "Net-PnL" that shows year-by-year spend (Year1 with 12% starter credit applied; Years2–3 with the 10% multi-year discount). For quick visibility: Year1 net = $2,180,000; Year2 net = $2,400,000; Year3 net = $2,400,000 (example numbers, finals subject to exact node counts).
- Air-gapped certs: standard per-node license uses a one-time signed license file with a 3-year validity by default. We can extend to 5 years under enterprise terms to avoid frequent manual renewals.
- Ops-retainer one-pager: included in the single-page PDF (we will merge into the draft-SOW if you accept the 3-year commit).

Operational note: if Acme wants to capitalize the platform fee, your accounting team may prefer a 36-month amort schedule; Redwood will provide the invoice schedule that shows the split by year to make the internal audit straightforward.

Next steps: If you confirm an intent to sign a 3-year commit, we'll update the SOW and prepare a DocuSign packet. Otherwise we can provide a month-to-month starter pilot with a smaller retainer.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Customer Ops — Redwood Inference
